question: The average price of three items of furniture is ₹16,050. If their prices are in the ratio 3 : 5 : 7, the price of the cheapest item (in ₹) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The average of the ratio values 3, 5, and 7 is (3 + 5 + 7) ÷ 3 = 5 units.

Here, 5 units correspond to the average price of ₹16,050.

1 unit = 16,050 ÷ 5 = ₹3,210.

The price of the cheapest item is 3 units = 3 × 3,210 = ₹9,630.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹9,630.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average price of three items = ₹16,050

Ratio of their prices = 3 : 5 : 7

**Formula Used:**

Sum of values = Average × Number of items

 Average = ₹16,050 → Total = 3 × 16,050 = ₹48,150
 
 
 3x
 Cheapest
 
 5x
 
 7x
 

 Total = 15x
 
 15x = 48,150 ⇒ x = 3,210 ⇒ 3x = ₹9,630

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the prices of the three items be 3x, 5x, and 7x respectively.

⇒ Total price of the three items = 3x + 5x + 7x = 15x

⇒ Average price = Total price ÷ 3

⇒ 15x ÷ 3 = 16,050

⇒ 5x = 16,050

⇒ x = 16,050 ÷ 5 = 3,210

⇒ The price of the cheapest item is 3x.

⇒ Cheapest item price = 3 × 3,210 = ₹9,630

**∴ The correct answer is ₹9,630.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average (Arithmetic Mean)

The average is the sum of all observations divided by the total number of observations: Average = Sum of observations ÷ Number of observations.

Ratio & Proportion

A ratio compares two or more quantities. When an amount is divided in the ratio a : b : c, the parts are proportional to ax, bx, and cx respectively, where x is the common multiplier.

Properties of Averages

If every observation in a dataset is multiplied or divided by a constant 'k', the new average will also be multiplied or divided by 'k' respectively.
